name: realm-icon-src
description: The Realm app icon. The shipped icon (resources/icon.png + icon.icns) and the Dock alternates Settings offers are generated artwork laid onto the macOS icon grid by compose-alternates.py (python3 + Pillow + iconutil), which also builds the .icns. app-icon.svg / mark.svg remain the mark's geometry — the reference every generation was given — and render.mjs still renders the flat vector icon from them. vgpu and pngjs are for render-candidates.mjs / render-dock.mjs, which draw the WGSL studies in candidates/. Not part of the pnpm workspace.
